The pipeline must not crash on these control characters when building the HTTP request or running keyword-extraction regex; OpenAlex's own search may or may not tolerate them gracefully, so either VERIFIED (if OpenAlex's search is robust to it) or NOT_FOUND (if it isn't) is an acceptable live outcome -- the invariant under test is no exception and no silent corruption into a different, unintended query.

why_this_is_hard: Invisible Unicode characters are a known real-world obfuscation technique (used to evade text filters); this checks the pipeline's HTTP/regex layers degrade gracefully rather than throwing or being tricked into matching something unintended.
